name: Contract views keep a qualified namespace and derived hash

input.fixture_ref: fixture: {setup: "Class A implements Contract C#m separately from ordinary A#m; Contract D has a distinct m slot; saved views over the same receiver and over equal identity-less receivers are compared and hashed", source: "[(a as C)..m(), (a as C).m(), (a as C) == (a as C), (a as C) == (a as D), (1 as C) == (1 as C), (1 as C).hash()]"}

applicability.reason: Requires qualified `super` inside a Contract slot. Three of the four halves this row asserts DO work: qualified dispatch `(a as C)..n()` selects the Contract slot, an ordinary `a.n()` stays ordinary, and view equality holds across two views of one receiver. The fourth does not: a subclass whose `impl` calls `super()` answers TypeError when reached through a Contract view, so qualified super cannot be observed staying in the qualified slot.

expect.status: Qualified Contract dispatch selects the Contract slot, ordinary sends remain ordinary, equality includes both receiver relation and Contract identity, qualified super stays in the qualified slot, and the view hash uses the C090 BLAKE3-derived input with receiver hash failures propagated.
